ark.small: {{amount}} {{unit}} expired, too few to recover on their own. They are recovered with the next coins that expire.
ark.smallInfo: A recovery makes one new coin, and the Ark server makes no coin below its minimum size. These sats are still yours: once more coins expire, Recover takes them all together.
ark.sweeping: {{amount}} {{unit}} expired. You can recover them once the Ark server has swept their batch.
ark.sweepingInfo: Ark coins live in a batch that expires; Ghostly renews them before that while it is open. Coins that expired are still yours, but first the Ark server takes their batch back on-chain (a sweep). That waits for new Bitcoin blocks, often an hour or more. Until then they cannot be spent or recovered; after it, Recover moves them into a new batch.
